profile.nameJa: ベト・シェメシュのヨシュア
profile.subtitleJa: ベト・シェメシュの畑の持ち主
profile.summaryJa: サムエル記上6:14は、契約の箱を載せた車がベト・シェメシュのヨシュアの畑に止まったと記します。本文はこのヨシュアを、町の畑の持ち主として示します。
profile.identityNoteJa: ここでのヨシュアは「ベト・シェメシュのヨシュア」と記され、ヌンの子ヨシュアとは別人です。

primaryWitnesses.textualBasisJa: The cart came into the field of Joshua of Beth Shemesh, and stood there, where there was a great stone. Then they split the wood of the cart and offered up the cows for a burnt offering to the LORD.

and the golden mice, according to the number of all the cities of the Philistines belonging to the five lords, both of fortified cities and of country villages, even to the great stone on which they set down the LORD’s ark. That stone remains to this day in the field of Joshua of Beth Shemesh.
